Details: Verge Knit | 100% Polyester Waffle | 6.3 oz. | Elastic waistband with interior drawstring | Leg Zipper with Boombah logo pull | 32" Inseam (measured from a Large) | Loose Fit | Imported Fabric | Made in USA
